description: The user arranged the desk: which view is on the stage, and for each side that has anything docked, whether it is open, which views it holds, and which one it shows.

stage.description: The address of the view on the stage, or null when nothing is staged.

docks.description: Each side that has anything docked. A side that is absent holds nothing and is closed.

open.description: The dock is open: its views are visible. Folded (false) keeps them docked but hidden.

views.description: The addresses (4.1) of the views docked on this side, in order.

active.description: The address of the tab this side shows; absent means the first.
